items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Taking a walk after dinner is linked to a rise in sugar about 18.3 mg/dL smaller. Walking for 10 to 19 minutes got most of the gain, with a rise 17.5 mg/dL smaller in sugar.

items.title: Keep dinner early
items.text: Having dinner before 8 pm is a good idea, as sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners across the program. None of your 14 scored dinners started at 8 pm or later, so keep it that way.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You averaged 14.0 hours of overnight fast, with 88.9% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone in the program.
